invoices_issued_fields_ck.name: invoices_issued_fields_ck
invoices_issued_fields_ck.value: "invoices"."state" not in ('issued', 'void') or ("invoices"."rendered_message" is not null and "invoices"."template_version" is not null and "invoices"."issued_by" is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null)

invoices_rejected_fields_ck.name: invoices_rejected_fields_ck
invoices_rejected_fields_ck.value: "invoices"."state" <> 'rejected' or (length(trim(coalesce("invoices"."rejected_reason", ''))) > 0 and "invoices"."rejected_by" is not null and "invoices"."rejected_at" is not null)

invoices_void_fields_ck.name: invoices_void_fields_ck
invoices_void_fields_ck.value: "invoices"."state" <> 'void' or (length(trim(coalesce("invoices"."void_reason", ''))) > 0 and "invoices"."voided_by" is not null and "invoices"."voided_at" is not null)

jobs_assigned_ck.name: jobs_assigned_ck
jobs_assigned_ck.value: "jobs"."status" not in ('assigned', 'in_progress') or "jobs"."assigned_to" is not null

jobs_cancelled_ck.name: jobs_cancelled_ck
jobs_cancelled_ck.value: "jobs"."status" <> 'cancelled' or "jobs"."cancelled_at" is not null or "jobs"."assigned_to" is null
